## Bigger sun, thicker outline, slower reader

The boot-screen sun is now 1.75x bigger, because the old one looked like it was compensating for something and honestly so was I. It's a whole sunset scene now. Very dramatic. You have three seconds to appreciate it before the app moves on, so don't blink.

ALL CLEAR and DETECTIONS LOGGED got a proper 2px black outline this time — the 1px version from last release was fine, but "fine" isn't really the brand. Now it actually pops off the background instead of politely suggesting it might be there.

And on the web flasher: Squachy's speech bubbles now stay up twice as long. Turns out some of you can read faster than a cryptid can type, who knew. All the little choreographed bits — the dance, the fake bolt he "finds" and "fixes," falling asleep mid-sentence — got stretched proportionally too, so nothing cuts off early or steps on its own punchline.

### The actually-useful part
- Web flasher: Squachy's bubble text now displays for 2x as long across every animation (idle chatter, dance, jokes, sleep/wake, the dismantle bit, victory dance, board ID) — paired timers scaled to match so the choreography stays in sync
- ALL CLEAR / DETECTIONS LOGGED outline widened from 1px to 2px
- Boot-screen sun radius increased 1.75x (30px → 53px)
